card.name: Words leading into a purpose clause
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "to" (or "out" of) right after a noun or verb phrase in technical or procedural text, where a purpose or result is about to be stated. It also fires on a few odd spots such as "list" in a command listing.

modes.label: Purpose "to"
modes.description: The word "to" after a described step or component, introducing what it is used to do or determine.
